request.subject: PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Turn it into a spooky ghost galleon: the hull becomes near-black charcoal wood, colour #2a2a30, with pale ivory bone ribs and a skull on the bow; the grey castles become black wood; the red sails become tattered dark charcoal grey cloth, colour #5a5660, with torn zigzag edges; the pennants become black rags; small lanterns glow bright violet. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
